headline: Sensex and Nifty trade higher led by rally in IT stocks and foreign fund inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong buying in IT stocks led by Infosys and TCS pushed market indices higher.
Foreign institutional investors poured funds into Indian equities, boosting broader market sentiment.
UBS and Bank of America raised target prices for Siemens, creating interest in the stock.
Sugar sector shares witnessed surging buying demand with gains of up to 14%.
whatHappening: Sensex opened in the green while Nifty traded near the 25,800 level.
The Nifty IT index rose over 2% with IT majors leading market gains.
Gold and Silver opened higher on Nov 26, reaching Rs 1,22,740 and Rs 1,45,800 respectively.
Bajaj Twins featured among the top market losers in early trade.
summary:
Indian equity markets traded higher on November 26, 2026, supported by foreign fund inflows.
Nifty hovered around 25,800 while Nifty IT index surged over 2% led by Infosys and TCS.
Sugar shares and select stocks like Siemens saw buying interest, while Bajaj Twins lagged behind.
